title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-03-01
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway
source: Recording Info: SBD Master Reels -> Dat (Panasonic 3700); Transfer Info: Delta DiO 2496 sound card > HD > CD-R; Mastering Info: HD > CD WAV > Cool Edit > Trader's Little Helper 2.7 > xACT 2.35 FLAC 8; Mastering by Seth Kaplan (alligator69@optonline.net) March 25, 2015

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard recording with brief cuts and a mellow set highlighted by strong Cumberland Blues and King Bee performances
ai_review.review: The tape offers clear, mostly outstanding sound despite a few short drops; the band delivers an okay night that leans toward mellow after feedback on The Other One. Highlights include a standout Cumberland Blues, a spot‑on King Bee from Pigpen, plus energetic Big Boy Pete, Peaches & Cream and High Cotton, while Uncle John's Band feels overly slow.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is average with several strong song moments but also some down‑tempo missteps; recording quality is generally good to excellent, leading to a combined rating just under 4 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound with brief tape cuts and occasional feedback during The Other One; reviewers note the audio is outstanding apart from minor imperfections.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A generally mellow set that loses some momentum after feedback on The Other One; the band experiments with slower tempos on Uncle John's but recovers with energetic numbers later in the show.
